corrections.text: The article says a "similar interface appeared the next day on a third-party platform" (Perplexity's Decider V1.1 27B). The only source for that paragraph is an OpenRouter search-results listing that shows October 7, 2026 as OpenRouter's listing date; it does not state when Perplexity released the model, and its "same API contract" wording refers to Perplexity's earlier Decider V1 27B, not to OpenAI's Decisions API. The similarity to OpenAI's interface and the one-day timing are the article's characterization, not statements by OpenRouter or Perplexity.
